name: cayfore
description: Cayfore is an independent Databricks cost calculator and DBU forecast.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w @cayfore/catalog && npm run typecheck -w @cayfore/engine && npm run build -w @cayfore/web && npm run build -w @cayfore/mcp
scripts.test: vitest run --coverage && node --test scripts/parse-prices.test.mjs scripts/validate-catalog.test.mjs scripts/catalog-watch.test.mjs scripts/coverage-report.test.mjs scripts/rate-confidence.test.mjs scripts/https-allowlist.test.mjs scripts/workspace-host.test.mjs scripts/usage-export.test.mjs scripts/lockfile-integrity.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cayfore/catalog && npm run typecheck -w @cayfore/engine && npm run typecheck -w @cayfore/web && npm run typecheck -w @cayfore/mcp
